items.context: Since D2 settled on a zero-parameter method, VerifyIdentity must construct its own HTTPClient internally. The existing HTTPClient in cliutil already supports APIBaseOptions with env var resolution. The question is whether to create a fresh client per call or expose an option to inject one for testing/reuse.

options.label: Create fresh HTTPClient per call using DetermineAPIBase
options.rationale: Simplest approach. VerifyIdentity is called once per CLI invocation at most. Creates NewHTTPClient with APIBaseOptions{EnvVars: ["VROOLI_AGENT_MANAGER_API_BASE"]} and 10s timeout. Tests use t.Setenv to point at httptest server. No API surface bloat. Recommended.

options.label: Package-level DefaultIdentityClient variable (overridable for tests)
options.rationale: Set a package-level var that VerifyIdentity uses. Tests override it. More testable but introduces mutable global state — goes against the clean pattern in sandbox.go.

items.context: When agent-manager returns 401, the HTTPClient.Do method returns a *APIError (via ParseAPIError). VerifyIdentity needs to extract the verify-specific response (valid=false, error message) from this. The question is how to handle the 401 path — parse the APIError's raw response or make a separate parsing path.

options.label: Type-assert *APIError, parse RawResponse into VerifyResult
options.rationale: HTTPClient.Do already captures the response body in APIError.RawResponse. VerifyIdentity checks errors.As(*APIError) for 401, then json.Unmarshal the RawResponse into VerifyResult. Reuses existing infrastructure. Recommended.

options.label: Use a lower-level HTTP call to avoid APIError wrapping
options.rationale: Bypass HTTPClient.Do and use the raw http.Client directly. More control over response parsing but duplicates request setup logic (headers, base URL, JSON encoding).

items.topic: Env var constant naming and placement
items.context: The identity env var names (VROOLI_AGENT_IDENTITY_TOKEN, VROOLI_AGENT_MANAGER_API_BASE) should be defined as constants for maintainability. sandbox.go doesn't use constants (inline strings), but identity.go has two env vars that will be referenced in tests.

options.label: Exported constants in identity.go
options.rationale: Define EnvIdentityToken and EnvAgentManagerBase as exported constants at the top of identity.go. Tests and consuming scenarios can reference them. Self-documenting. Recommended.

options.label: Inline strings matching sandbox.go pattern
options.rationale: Keep consistency with sandbox.go which uses os.Getenv("VROOLI_SANDBOX_ID") inline. Simpler but harder to keep in sync if env var names ever change.

items.text: All 4 round-1 decisions have been incorporated into the plan. The approach is now fully detailed: token-only IdentityEnv, zero-parameter VerifyIdentity method, env var for base URL, transport/auth error separation. The plan includes 8 specific test cases covering all paths.

This plan appears ready for execution. All readiness dimensions are at 3 except risk_awareness (2), which is adequate for an S-effort item with straightforward stdlib-only implementation. The file change set is minimal (2 files), the test strategy is concrete, and all design decisions are settled. Consider reviewing and queuing.
